[P1] Justin Chatwin
Justin Chatwin ( born October 31 , 1982 ) is a Canadian actor . First broadcast on BBC One on 25 December 2016 , it is the twelfth Christmas special since the show 's revival in 2005 . It is written by Steven Moffat and directed by Ed Bazalgette . The episode stars Peter Capaldi as the Twelfth Doctor , and is the first to feature Nardole ( Matt Lucas ) as his companion , having been introduced in the previous episode `` The Husbands of River Song '' . The episode received generally positive reviews from critics .
